pages.title: https://jordanvalleyresort.com/ | Jordan Valley Resort – A Serene Getaway for Families and Leisure Seekers
pages.lines:
3 years ago
Last minute gem discovered for our stay in the St. Catherine's area!Located in a nice quiet area with amenities close by, Jordan Valley Resort is a lovely place.We stayed in the Napa Tiny Home and cannot recommend enough trying it out. Plenty of storage, a nice shower and washer/dryer if needed. The comforts of home while camping and the air conditioning was a delightful surprise. Definitely needed for our weekend!Notable cons to mention would be we did find some rodent poop around (in the fridge of all places) but honestly to be expected while "camping." Also we were informed the oven door shattered in transit (pictured) with no solution for it. We did not need the oven but it was concerning with our toddler running around. We made due and cleaned up any missed glass and covered it with a garbage bag and it was no issue.If you plan on visiting the campground, definitely try to book the tiny home. Worth the cost per night and we will definitely be booking again!
Matt Fitzpatrick
